summary.intent: User noticed the summary TUI only showed 9 sessions and wanted to understand why, expecting more sessions to be visible.
summary.outcome: Diagnosed that the TUI's default 'Repo' filter (main/master branches only) was limiting the visible sessions from the 200-row query result; no code changes were made.

repo: loadSummarySessions in summary_cmd.go fetches up to maxSummaryRecentSessions=200 rows, then the TUI applies a branch filter client-side
The TUI has three filter modes cycleable with 'f': Repo (main/master), Current Branch, and All
Default TUI filter is 'Repo' (main/master), which is why only 9 of 200 recent sessions were visible — only 12 total sessions exist on main/master
Database contains 2,480 total sessions; most are on feature branches like agent-improvements (123 sessions in recent 200)

code.finding: loadSummarySessions uses maxSummaryRecentSessions=200 as the query limit; a separate defaultSummarySessionLimit=10 exists as a post-filter cap for the --last flag

workflow: When a TUI shows unexpectedly few results, check whether client-side filtering is the culprit before assuming a query or data issue

friction: Default TUI filter (Repo/main) is surprising — most active work is on feature branches, making the default view appear nearly empty
open_items: Decide whether to increase the default query limit, change the default TUI filter to 'Current Branch' or 'All', or leave behavior as-is
